outputs: Generated text summaries of event mentions that are concatenated with original contexts for joint representation learning and event coreference clustering.

changes_made.explanation: This paper is about event coreference resolution (information extraction), not NLG. The LLM summarization is an intermediate step to aid coreference resolution, not the primary task being evaluated. The paper evaluates coreference clustering performance, not the quality of generated summaries.
The metrics mentioned (MUC, B3, CEAF-e, CoNLL, LEA) are coreference resolution metrics, not NLG evaluation metrics. They measure clustering quality, not text generation quality.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper is fundamentally about information extraction (event coreference resolution), not natural language generation. The LLM summarization is used as an intermediate processing step to extract better features for coreference resolution. The evaluation focuses on coreference clustering performance using standard IE metrics, not on evaluating the quality of generated text. The original extraction incorrectly categorized this as an NLG paper.
